name: normalHurt
description: Calculates basic attack damage for players, pals, and cannons

parameters.usePierceResist: boolean, default true — whether to apply pierce/block

formula_steps.formula: ATK = attacker.att, DEF = defender.def, DEF_COE = defender.def_coe

formula_steps.description: Calculate base damage with defense coefficient
Get multiplier and resistance based on unit type

formula_steps.formula: if (crit_flag != 1): dmg = roundInt(dmg * max(1.5, round(crit_dam / crit_def)))

simplified_formula.player: max(1, calHurt(roundInt(max(roundInt(ATK - DEF*(1+DEF_COE)), 1) * round(att_dam * round(1 - pierce_block(att_resist)))), defender, attacker) * crit_multiplier)
simplified_formula.pal: max(1, calHurt(roundInt(max(roundInt(parentATK - DEF*(1+DEF_COE)), 1) * round(partner_dam * partner_dam_extra * round(1 - suppress_inspire(partner_resist)))), defender, attacker) * crit_multiplier)
